item: Identify actual Québec site and operator
evidence_needed: Site address, operator, utility account/service ID (keep sensitive IDs private)
Approved drawings, nameplate ratings, utility accepted load limit
Written vendor/integrator confirmation, architecture, tests with four chargers
Documented local fallback limits and test results for cloud, meter, controller failure

item: Confirm Rate BR eligibility and bill formula
evidence_needed: Actual bill and Hydro-Québec tariff confirmation for this public charging site
Prefer 15-minute meter data plus charger/session data across comparable days
Completed by departure, delivered/requested kWh, wait, failed/abandoned sessions
Factor year, average vs marginal method, same-energy baseline comparison
Meter/control logs during recovery and resumption after peak period
Compare predicted interval kW/kWh with held-out observed data
